name: Sakaki Misako
source:
Sakaki Michiaki’s wife and Yumiko’s mother. Her former family name is “Komoto”. [spoiler] The Komoto family is an old lineage family which manages real estate in Old Town at Kanagawa prefecture so her marriage with Michiaki was a political marriage of convenience. Her body isn’t much healthy.[/spoiler] 

[From [url=http://vnsharing.net/forum/showthread.php?t=302644/]Shiori-chan's review[/url].]
